parsed_entries.requirement: Data fiduciaries must provide information to the Central Government upon request for purposes specified in the Seventh Schedule.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies procedures for providing information to the Central Government upon request.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries and intermediaries.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation applies when the Central Government requests information for specified purposes.

parsed_entries.requirement: Disclosure of information requested by the Central Government may be restricted if it affects India's sovereignty, integrity, or security.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies conditions under which information disclosure to the Central Government is restricted.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries and intermediaries.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation applies when disclosure of information may prejudice India's sovereignty, integrity, or security.

parsed_entries.requirement: The term 'intermediary' is defined in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document defines 'intermediary' in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries and intermediaries.
parsed_entries.notes: This defines the term 'intermediary' for the purposes of the DPDP Rules 2025.

parsed_entries.requirement: Consent Managers must ensure that their platform enables Data Principals to give, manage, review, and withdraw consent in accordance with published data protection standards.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that the platform enables Data Principals to give, manage, review, and withdraw consent in accordance with published standards.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures that Consent Managers align with published data protection standards.

parsed_entries.requirement: Consent Managers must enable Data Principals to give consent to the processing of their personal data by a Data Fiduciary onboarded onto the platform.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that the platform enables Data Principals to give consent to the processing of their personal data by a Data Fiduciary.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures that Consent Managers facilitate consent for data processing.

parsed_entries.requirement: Consent Managers must enable Data Principals to give consent to the processing of their personal data by a Data Fiduciary through another Data Fiduciary onboarded onto the platform.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that the platform enables Data Principals to give consent through another Data Fiduciary.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures that Consent Managers support indirect consent through other Data Fiduciaries.
